title: Template -- Windows account created
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical Sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1136 (Create Account). Detects Windows Security event 4720, which records a newly created user account. Account creation needs an ownership and change-record check because the event alone does not establish malicious intent. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
